verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents an in-dashboard AI support assistant that uses documentation and known solutions to help resolve common issues before a support ticket is opened, so a built-in assistant exists. It is a troubleshooting helper, though, not an agent that performs tasks on the user's behalf. The MCP server and coding-agent plugins are external tools, not built-in, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence the built-in assistant can take actions (create or modify connections, trigger syncs, configure transformations), scope and permission controls for delegated actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
